node.title: Re^3: Passing a value to Mojo::Template template
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Could I combine all of it into one variable and than pass to "$mt->render_file()"?

I'm not sure I fully understand the question... do you mean something like the following (which works too)? If not, please provide more context, preferably in the form of an [id://1177642|SSCCE] (see also [id://174051]).

my %vars = ( data => $data, test => $code, color => 'blue' ); print $mt->render_file( 'myfile.html.ep', \%vars );
